name: pptx-runtime
author: octos
description: Rust-native PPTX authoring, direct PNG rendering and review evidence using DeckCraft

tools.name: pptx_tool
tools.description: Build/edit editable PPTX, render PNG, inspect layout, enforce native QA gates, propose text fit, localize text with OCR (macOS), compare/crop images and record review evidence. No Python, Node or LibreOffice. Read the pptx skill for schemas; action=help lists operations. Outputs are workspace files. Read returned PNGs with read_file to review their pixels; success does not approve design. Use operations to combine crop/OCR/patch/cycle steps in one call; explicit images and review_view return pixels directly to the model. Stops on first failed step; no automatic quality approval. page_gate returns per-page work_stage; page_dispatch checks declared ready-work coverage and serial reviewer queues without scheduling or grading.

ocr.description: Source OCR file for source_lines intake

additional_lines.description: Extra lines observed on the original in OCR canvas coordinates

repair_review.description: page_assemble: previous independently submitted failing final verdict binding for a coordinator to replace its reviewed deck and renders after approved page repairs.

assembly.description: assembly_review_submit or per_page evidence_assembled: persisted native page_assemble receipt path for the delivered PPTX.

report.description: Independent reviewer report path for source_copy_review or assembly_review_submit.

qa.description: evidence_assembled: delivery path for the runtime's combined package and independent QA JSON.

check_renderer.description: doctor: exercise picture scaling and check the rendered pixels.

probe_fixture_output.description: doctor: write the synthetic probe PPTX to a new workspace path.

probe_render_receipt.description: doctor: check an existing same-engine render of the probe at width 320.

refresh_render_only.description: page_publish: assigned v2 reviewer changes only the preview of the exact existing candidate; supply page, candidate_id and render_receipt.

resume_after_round.description: page_assignments with only_page: resume the required owner after its specified terminal peer round ended with work still unfinished. The host verifies the current terminal record. Replays of that round are deduplicated.

only_page.description: page_gate: validate only this page and its bound evidence. This query makes no deck-wide assembly decision.

stage_repair_render.description: page_assemble with repair_review: stage an independently authorized repair for rendering with the approved DeckCraft deployment before promotion.

template_output.description: assembly_review_submit: write an unanswered, source-bound observations template to a new non-delivery JSON path. Supply assembly and render_receipt. Omit observations, report and output until submitting.

freeze_inputs.description: build or cycle: the assigned maker freezes its resolved one-page and root JSON before building, including when rendering and publication occur later.

candidate_id.description: page_review_submit: opaque identifier from the exact page publication the reviewer inspected.

verdict_id.description: page_repair_decide: exact signed verdict under independent arbitration.

finding_observations.description: page_repair_decide: independent observations at presentation scale, keyed by each manual finding ID.

replaces_verdict_id.description: page_review_submit: current verdict identifier when revising an existing native verdict.

blocked_report.description: page_review_submit: bind a finished specialist report to the existing rejected verdict using candidate_id and replaces_verdict_id. Omit verdict.

verdict.description: Independent decision for page_review_submit. Fill the review_request_template from the candidate handoff or page_gate(only_page). Put per_page delivery_checks inside verdict and include your actual evidence.

open_required_findings.description: For a requirement involving known editable text IDs and exact source wording, include native_text mapping each stable ID to its expected string.

source_detail_review.description: For image reconstruction, complete the source regions in the review template. Record glyph inclination separately from baseline tilt, retain earlier findings and bind the original and current render.

delivery_checks.description: Required for accepted per_page verdicts. Include all four keys: copy, artwork, readability, editability. Each must have status equal to the string pass and basis containing the specific evidence observed for this page.

basis.description: What you actually observed in the reviewed page.

output_page.description: patch: emit only this page's source JSON at output. Every edit and artwork update must target this page. All source JSON is bound and structurally validated; only the selected page's assets are checked. Assemble the page into a root spec and run a full build to check every page's assets.

pack.description: review_submit: immutable review_pack report.json that supplied the review_id.

observations.description: review_submit: review_id and object_reviews JSON path. For assembly_review_submit: independent per-page final observations JSON path; help topic assembly_review_submit gives the schema.

previous_cycle.description: For review_pack: the bound cycle before the revision. Creates matched before/current crops and finding changes.

pages.description: review_pack: select source page IDs. Omit on a multi-page cycle to get a lightweight plan of per-page requests; final review must cover every page.

page_numbers.description: For review_pack: 1-based display page numbers in this exact cycle. Use instead of pages when the user names slide numbers. Returns the authoritative page_number/page_id/render map.

ink_align.description: For fit: align visible glyph ink to the target without changing source or font size.

reflow.description: fit only: rebuild layout at target box width before aligning visible ink. Default false preserves translation-only behavior.

group.description: fit: declared typography group, one chosen exact size, and explicit targets for all members. No min/max options. An infeasible member withholds all group edits.

parts.description: split_text: ordered native text fragments with independently chosen boxes and optional style/rotation/format/region. Every canonical character, including operators, must be retained.

id.description: layout_search, split_text or represent_symbol: native text object ID within page.

group_id.description: layout_region: existing typography group constraining size_pt.

sizes_pt.description: layout_region: explicit common font-size alternatives. Returns complete candidates, never a partial group.

padding_px.description: layout_region: explicit inset from each local owner region.

basis.description: represent_symbol: why the existing raster symbol represents this canonical symbol. Requires independent pixel review; explanation is not proof.

area.description: layout_search: independently chosen local allowed area [x,y,width,height], in canvas pixels.

forbidden.description: layout_search: measured illustration/decoration rectangles or convex quads to avoid, in canvas pixels.

clearance_px.description: layout_search: required separation, frozen when registered; default 3 canvas px.

avoid_artwork.description: layout_search: conservatively avoid contrast edges in the bound background; default true. Not semantic segmentation.

register.description: layout_search: freeze object constraints for automatic actual-PPTX native QA in every later cycle/evidence_record. Does not edit deck source.

rotation.description: Explicit rigid label angle in degrees; must match the text rotation. Box is measured before rotation around its center.

targets.description: For fit with ink_align: desired visible-ink rectangles in canvas pixels, optionally rotated in their local axes. No perspective inference.

image.description: For geometry: actual blank image used to probe the proposed boundary. Quad units are source-image pixels.

guarded_text_edits.description: batch: refuse text.set and require a slide text.find match in text.replace.at. This guards common scope/formatting mistakes; it does not certify formatting or package preservation.

max_size_pt.description: fit: explicit maximum size, can permit growth. Omitted size bounds retain current size.

max_lines.description: fit: line limit applied even without frame overflow. Explicit newlines are preserved.

inspection.description: Optional compare_cycle: current inspect report created from this bound cycle, with canvas coordinate provenance.

labels.description: Optional standalone whole-page compare label hints: id, text, box in render pixels, font_px, rotation. cycle derives these and isolated ink automatically.

background.description: Optional compare mode: blank artwork corresponding to the actual render. Produces contextual design/blank/render crops and background-subtracted signals.

tolerance.description: Pixel neighborhood tolerance for background-subtracted compare; not a quality threshold.

regions.description: For compare: measure multiple named rectangles in the original before and after images in one call, with a common origin and scale. Returns RGB means and absolute errors. Can save a JSON receipt.

box.description: x, y, width, height in source pixels

reason.description: Why the final delivery paths changed; task/checks/history stay unchanged.

extend_scope_reason.description: For evidence_record: explicitly add pages after the previous batch passed. Retains all prior pages, findings and attempts.

comparisons.description: For evidence_record: whole-page comparison manifest from compare_cycle for a legacy cycle.

reuse_comparisons.description: For cycle/compare_cycle: previous comparison manifest; reuse only unchanged reference/blank/render bytes.

previous_review.description: assembly_review_submit: previous verdict SHA-256 when revising an existing verdict. review_pack: prior bound review with previous_cycle. Rust reuses only identical local pixels and unchanged neighboring declarations.

verification_mode.description: evidence_init only. A version 2 plan with multiple pages defaults to per_page and requires a distinct independent reviewer_session for every page. Other tasks default to strict. Page verdicts in per_page mode are final before compilation. independent_visual uses a designated whole-deck reviewer.

reviewer_agent.description: evidence_init: exact independent reviewer session identity from peer handoff; not a nickname.

arbiter_agent.description: evidence_init with independent_visual: optional frozen session identity, distinct from the policy owner and Reviewer, allowed to adjudicate a registered fidelity false positive using current bound evidence. In a shared page fleet the coordinator is the policy owner and cannot also be arbiter. Cannot be added after work starts.

findings.description: finding_register: stable id, page, object_id or box, check, state open, note. Captures current pixels immediately before repairs.

topic.description: action=help: request focused evidence/review documentation or patch/batch capability information.

steps.description: operations: ordered ordinary pptx_tool requests, stop at first failure; no nested operations.

images.description: operations: workspace image paths to attach after the steps.

groups.description: review_view: selected zero-based reading-group indexes; returns actual pixels plus measurements.

receipt.description: crop: write an immutable processing receipt.

artwork_layers.description: patch: rows {page,layers} replace the complete local raster-layer array on selected pages. Each layer has id,image,box,optional rotation,basis; painted above background and below editable text. Relative images use the source spec directory. Included in the same checked cycle.

reuse.description: crop: verified prior receipt binding; reuse only matching input bytes, algorithm and viewport. No visual verdict is reused.

reviews.description: review_merge: direct, bound review_submit output paths for this exact cycle. Independent provenance is revalidated; conflicting observations are rejected.

all_pages.description: review_pack: explicitly opt into one combined pack. By default an unscoped multi-page cycle returns a lightweight page request plan without generating crops.

publish_candidate.description: cycle: atomically publish the current one-page native candidate for its declared maker; no quality approval or peer notification.

artifact.description: page_publish: preserve this actual post-build PPTX, backed by native receipts and its render.

render_receipt.description: page_publish: native render receipt for the actual current PPTX.

receipts.description: page_publish: ordered native post-build receipt paths; not model-authored approval claims.

assignments.description: page_dispatch: coordinator-declared peer jobs. All phases after make require the current candidate SHA-256 for active coverage. Arbitration and technical diagnosis are dispatchable peer work.

peers.description: page_dispatch: coordinator-declared current peer availability; preserve unknown. Neither this input nor output is host-verified execution evidence.
